facet_combination: For the modified profile only, review every required facet independently with the unchanged conditional rubric. Parent score is the minimum only when all original/modified evidenced facets have explicit applicable modified-context evidence. Otherwise parent is null. Facets never become extra aggregate items.
inheritance: No original numeric value is silently inherited by a modified proposal. Applicability must be explicitly confirmed, then re-reviewed with conditional anchors.
blockers: Original blockers are retained. Their modified status is unresolved unless all relevant facets are addressed by confirmed modified evidence; an addressed viewing boundary never resolves safety/security.

templates.original_check: For {topic}, does your earlier view still describe your position on the unchanged original proposal? You may confirm it or explain a correction.
templates.requested_change: Hypothetically, suppose the changes you described for {topic} were met: {condition}. Would all the aspects you raised for this topic be acceptable, or what would remain? This assumes your requested condition only; feasibility is not established.
